apps.localizedDescription: Create workout sessions with exercises, sets, weights, repetitions, and rest times. Follow your plan in practice mode, check off completed sets, and run a rest countdown. Import and export workout plans as JSON. Workout data stays on your device. This Classic edition does not include the Live Activity widget or Apple Watch app.
